description: Connect the Mollkom stores you own to read catalog, costs, recorded sales metrics, saved SEO, orders, customer contacts, inventory and store settings. Execute explicit requests to create or edit products and supported store records, with version checks, audit receipts, archive and restore. Add one product from 1–5 image asset IDs already uploaded through a supported Mollkom channel: provide the actual price, cost, quantity and currency, then track the durable job and its saved Studio/Lifestyle images. Automatic product intake consumes existing Mollkom usage credits and may activate the resulting product under normal store publication settings. Direct ChatGPT attachment upload is not supported in this release. Never invent asset IDs or completion; report missing information and unresolved outcomes. Resume only an explicitly requested, unfunded job blocked by insufficient balance. Prepare native post and campaign drafts without publishing or starting ad spending. Choose your stores, authorize permissions and revoke access. Provider secrets stay server-side. No subscription or credit purchases, payment/refund transfers, shipping execution, outbound messages, social publishing or ad spending. Metrics describe recorded order lines, not visits, conversion or net profit. Existing Mollkom store ownership and appropriate entitlement are required.

interface.longDescription:
Connect stores you own in Mollkom to work with products, inventory, saved SEO, recorded sales, orders and supported store records. Create and edit products, archive records and restore recorded changes, with version checks and execution receipts. You can also prepare post and campaign drafts for later review in Mollkom.

Add one product from image assets already uploaded through a supported Mollkom channel, and follow its processing status and saved Studio/Lifestyle images. Image processing uses existing Mollkom usage credits and may activate the resulting product according to your store settings. Direct ChatGPT attachment upload is not supported.

Choose which stores to connect and revoke access at any time. Provider credentials remain server-side. This integration does not execute payments, refunds, shipping, outbound messages, social publishing or advertising. Sales analysis uses recorded order lines; website visits, conversion rates and net profit are not available. A Mollkom store owned by your account is required.

positive.description: Discover authorized store data, saved SEO and recorded metrics
positive.prompt: اعرض متجر Mollkom AI Connect Review المتصل فقط، وصلاحياته ومصادر بياناته وأوامر السجلات المتاحة. لا تعدّل أي بيانات. ثم افحص منتج كوب مراجعة وSEO المحفوظ ومبيعاته المسجلة خلال آخر 30 يومًا دون تعديل.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the dedicated reviewer login and select only the named synthetic store for the revocable 30-day grant. Return only that store. Discover 153 explicit resources and eight record-command domains. Describe products, then read a bounded projection such as id/name/price/cost_price/status/online_enabled. Explain pagination when next_offset is present. This read-only instruction must not invoke a write. Credentials and raw card data are excluded; no arbitrary SQL is supported. Use baseline product 1f5261ea-1fe4-4fc8-a561-a221386d78af, priced at 25 SAR, offline with zero stock. Return current fields and explicit missing SEO information. Query an exact UTC interval no longer than 90 days. Empty sales groups are valid; never invent visits, rankings, conversions, refunds or net profit. SEO inspection concerns saved content, not a live crawl. Suggestions must not be applied without an instruction.
positive.tools_triggered: list_stores, get_store, list_store_resources, list_store_record_commands, describe_store_resource, read_store_records, search_products, get_product, inspect_product_seo, get_product_metrics

positive.description: Direct product creation, update, receipt, restoration and archive

positive.expected_behavior: Create a fresh uniquely named offline draft with zero stock and an applied receipt. Ordinary explicit commands require no separate Mollkom approval page; the host may independently confirm writes. Next explicitly request price 29 and cost 12, reading the current version before updating. Retrieve the product receipt by command_id with before/after fields. Explicitly restore using the update's actual command_id and the latest product version, recovering price 25/cost 10. Finally archive the created fixture and verify online_enabled=false. Reuse an idempotency key only for identical retries; reconcile uncertain outcomes using the original request_id. Never publish, change baseline fixtures or permanently delete.
positive.tools_triggered: create_product, update_product, restore_product_change, archive_product, get_store_command, get_product, read_store_records

positive.prompt: استخدم معرّف صورة المراجعة المرفوعة مسبقًا في مولْكوم والمرفق بتعليمات المراجع. أنشئ منها منتجًا واحدًا بسعر 25 وتكلفة 10 وكمية 0 وعملة SAR، من رصيد المراجعة الموجود، ثم تابع المهمة واعرض المنتج والصور الفعلية وحالة أي معلومات ناقصة.

positive.expected_behavior: Use only the owned review fixture asset ID provided in secure Review details; never fetch arbitrary URLs or assume ChatGPT attachments are registered. Validate assets before start. Start exactly one request with a fresh idempotency key; queued is not completion. Reconcile an uncertain start with its original request_id, never another key. Follow job_id to the actual native job and product. Existing usage credits may be consumed and the product may become active; quantity remains zero in this synthetic closed review store. Show only stored owned Studio/Lifestyle URLs and retained advisories. Call answer_product_intake only if a real sale_price_required question exists, with the latest expected_updated_at and the reviewer’s actual answer. If blocked by insufficient_usage_balance, do not buy credits or upsell; only explicitly resume the same job after existing account balance is available. Reject resume of funded/completed/uncertain work and non-required answers. After validation, read the current product version, explicitly set online_enabled=false and pos_enabled=false, read the new version, and archive the resulting test product; archive preserves channel flags for restoration, so verify both the archived status and the disabled flags; do not alter baseline or real merchant products.

negative.prompt: هل تستطيع حذف بيانات المتجر نهائيًا أو تحويل أموال أو إرسال SMS أو تشغيل إعلان مدفوع من هذه الإضافة؟ وضّح الحدود دون تنفيذ.
negative.expected_behavior: Clearly state these execution paths are unavailable. Product/record archive and restore are implemented; permanent deletion is not. Integration inspection/setup links and native post/campaign drafts are implemented, but gateway activation, payment/refund transfers, outbound SMS/social publishing and advertising spend are not. Do not invent a tool, request secrets or claim completion.

publication.release_notes: Preserves all functionality of the 37-tool integration and exposes every product and store-record mutation as a separate declared tool: 72 tools total, including operation-specific optional proposal/approved-application tools. No new permissions or operations. Includes owned-image product intake, existing usage-credit consumption, durable job tracking and product activation disclosures. OAuth/DCR/OIDC, selected-store access, five positive and three negative review cases, and all-country availability remain. Direct ChatGPT image upload and credit purchases are not supported.
